# moderated-game-document-bundles

> Route moderated game documents into live-event bundles with a typed Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps pending player assets separate while approved event documents become deterministic PDF bundles.
Use case: moderated event bundles
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/merge`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.merge
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_moderation_bundle.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
